name: removed after breaking out
why: Confirmed on the 01-06 close and filled at the next open, 102 on 01-07, and dropped by the source on Saturday 01-10. The leg is closed at the last close on or before that date, 108 on 01-09, labelled removed: 5.88% before costs. The bars after it (a touch of the last full day on 01-12) are not the source's setup any more and are not read; the board's own type goes on counting them, which is why the board reads the setup as a B3, while the model types it as it stood on the removal date, a B2 (the 01-07 low, exactly the 100 trigger, is a pullback). With removed setups left out, the universe still counts the breakout and lists the setup under excluded.

excluded.reason: removed by the source after breaking out
